title: 第19章 破庙相持第20章 凤厌败龙雀1 0
slug: 北侯世子反派的我背景逆天
lines: 赵岚心生警惕，正准备偷偷从窗外望上一眼的时候，一道劲风掠过，随即，一把剑已经架在了他的脖子上。
“你这小子，倒是让老婆子我好找啊！还好老身在你身上留了个心眼······”
沙哑苍老的声音传来，赵岚定睛望去，发现蒙面人揭开了脸上的黑布，露出了那张老妇人的面孔。
“你是······先前在山谷里的那个······老婆婆？！”
“少套近乎！”
老妇人剑又逼近一寸，声音冷冽。
“早点将你抓去丢给那北侯世子，好让他早点信守承诺放了殿下！”
“婆婆，你说什么呢！我跟你们无冤无仇，我也敢保证，从来没有透露半点你们消息。”
赵岚咽咽口水，连忙安抚求饶。
“就是你这个灾星！”
老妇人厉声。
“引来了那北侯世子，强行掳走了殿下，你说你该不该死？”
“什么？仙女姐姐她······被裴苏给抓走了！”
赵岚愣神，心头涌起汹涌的怒火。
“这个裴家世子！我定要将他碎尸万段！”
“呃呵呵！”
老妇人忽然冷笑出声，像是听见了这个世上最好笑的笑话一般。
“就凭你？天赋、实力、身世，哪一样你不被裴苏碾成狗屎，大言不惭，废材逆袭的戏折子看多了是吧！”
说着老妇人便将剑转了个弯，逼迫着赵岚站起来。
“少废话，跟我去见北侯世子，至少他想怎么处置你，是他的事，只希望他能信守承诺······”
最后一句，老妇人冷冽的声音微微低沉下去，而赵岚仿佛看见了希望。
“婆婆！婆婆！不要信了那裴苏的鬼话，他就是披着翩翩公子外皮的恶鬼，他定然是看上了仙女妹妹的仙姿，即便你将我送过去，他也不可能会放人······”
见老妇人罕见没有反驳，赵岚心中大喜，继续道：
“婆婆，你一定要帮我！裴家上上下下都是奸臣，我现在身负天底下最大的秘密，绝不能死在这里，否则天下苍生都要遭殃！”
“秘密？”
老妇人眉头一皱，将剑继续横压过去，让赵岚冷汗直流。
“什么秘密，快说！”
赵岚咬着牙齿，恨声道：“婆婆你可能不相信，但事实如此！裴家联合皇后，害死了当今陛下！什么崆峒山闭关，就是一个欺骗天下人的骗局啊！”

Zhao Lan was wary, and when he was about to secretly take a look out of the window, a strong wind passed by, and then a sword was placed on his neck.
who? !
"You kid makes it easy for me to find my wife! Fortunately, I have kept an eye on you..."
A hoarse old voice came, and Zhao Lan looked intently and found that the masked man had removed the black cloth on his face, revealing the face of the old woman.
"Are you... the... old woman in the valley before?!"
"It's almost too late!"
The old woman's sword came closer an inch, her voice cold.
"I'll capture you as soon as possible and throw you to the Northern Marquis Prince, so that he can keep his promise and let His Highness go!"
"Mother-in-law, what are you talking about? I have no enmity or enmity with you, and I can guarantee that I will never reveal any information about you."
Zhao Lan swallowed and quickly comforted and begged for mercy.
"It's you, the disaster star!"
The old woman snapped.
"I attracted the Northern Marquis Crown Prince and forcibly kidnapped His Highness. Do you think you should die?"
"What? Sister Fairy... was captured by Pei Su!"
Zhao Lan was stunned, and rage surged in his heart.
"This heir apparent of the Pei family! I will cut him into pieces!"
"Uh-huh!"
The old woman suddenly sneered, as if she had heard the funniest joke in the world.
"It's just you? In terms of talent, strength, and life experience, you won't be crushed into shit by Pei Su, and you've seen too many dramas about useless people counterattacking without shame, right?"
As she spoke, the old woman turned her sword and forced Zhao Lan to stand up.
"Stop talking nonsense and follow me to see Prince Beihou. At least what he wants to do with you is his business. I just hope he can keep his promise..."
In the last sentence, the old woman's cold voice deepened slightly, and Zhao Lan seemed to see hope.
"Mother-in-law! Mother-in-law! Don't believe Pei Su's lies. He is an evil ghost in the skin of a handsome young master. He must have fallen in love with the fairy sister's beauty. Even if you send me there, he will never let me go..."
Seeing that the old woman rarely refuted, Zhao Lan was overjoyed and continued:
"Mother-in-law, you must help me! Everyone in the Pei family is full of traitors. I am now carrying the biggest secret in the world. I must not die here, otherwise everyone in the world will suffer!"
"Secret?"
The old woman frowned and continued to press the sword horizontally, causing Zhao Lan to break out in cold sweat.
"What's the secret? Tell me!"
"Just...just..."
Zhao Lan gritted her teeth and said bitterly: "Mother-in-law, you may not believe it, but it is true! The Pei family united with the queen to kill the current majesty! The Kongtong Mountain retreat is a scam to deceive the world!"
